City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 10, 2020 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Gay Pride Month Proclamation
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Public comments regarding items not listed on this agenda (oral communications) must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR Public comments regarding consent calendar items on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov.
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 15, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, May 18, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, May 20, 2020 Special Meeting, May 20, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, May 20, 2020 Regular Meeting, and May 27, 2020 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-06-10 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Acting Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-06-10 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
HOME Investment Partnership (HOME) Program San Diego County Consortium Participation Renewal. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-41 for continued participation, with automatic annual renewal, in the San Diego HOME Consortium for the three successive qualification periods of July 1, 2021 - June 30, 2022; July 1, 2022 - June 30, 2023; and July 1, 2023 - June 30 2024.
2020-06-10 Item 08C HOME Program Renewal
8D.
Grant application for the California Housing and Community Development (HCD) Local Early Action Planning Grants Program (Grant). Contact Person: Housing Consultant Schwarm
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-44 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City Of Encinitas Authorizing Application for, and receipt of, Local Early Action Planning Grants Program Funds” and authorizing the City Manager to enter into, execute and deliver a State of California Agreement for the amount of $300,000 .
2020-06-10 Item 08D LEAP Grant Application
8E.
Resolution accepting a report for state-mandated annual fire inspections in compliance with SB 1205. Contact Person: Acting Fire Marshal Schmidt
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-39 accepting a report on the status of all state-mandated annual fire inspections in the City of Encinitas in conjunction with SB 1205 and California Health and Safety Code Section 13146.4.
2020-06-10 Item 08E Resolution 2020-39 Accepting a Report for State Mandated Annual Fire Inspections in Compliance with SB 1205
8F.
Acceptance of the Sumps Phase III Project (CD17A & CD05E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-37 accepting the public improvements for the Sumps Phase III Project (CD17A & CD05E) as complete to the satisfaction of the City; authorizing the filing of the Notice of Completion for the Project; authorizing the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; and authorizing the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion.
2020-06-10 Item 08F NOC Leucadia Sumps Phase III
8G.
Environmental Education and Outreach Services Contracts. Contact Person:
Management Analyst Stratakis
Authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute one-year contracts in substantial forms as attached with Solana Center for Environmental Innovation, BCK Programs, and I Love A Clean San Diego, to provide environmental education and outreach services in support of the City’s Climate Action Plan and state-mandated laws, for a total amount not-to-exceed $854,866 over four years for all three contracts.
2020-06-10 Item 08G Environmental Educational Services Contract Awards
8H.
Approve the proposed changes to the remainder of the calendar year 2020 City Council Meeting Schedule and adopt City Council Resolution 2020-47 Approving the 2020 revised meeting schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the proposed changes to the remainder of the calendar year 2020 City Council Meeting Schedule and adopt City Council Resolution 2020-47 Approving the 2020 revised meeting schedule.
2020-06-10 Item 08H City Council Meeting Schedule Changes
8I.
Approval of plans, and specifications and authorization to advertise the Trail 95 (CP00F) Project. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Kirk
Approve the plans and specifications, and authorize advertisement for Trail 95 (CP00F).
2020-06-10 Item 08I Approval of Plans and Authorization to Advertise the Trail 95 (CP00F) Project
8J.
Second Reading of Ordinance 2020-08 establishing new speed limits on South Coast Highway 101. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Adopt Ordinance 2020-08 titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limits on South Coast Highway 101” including the Engineering and Traffic Survey.
2020-06-10 Item 08J S101 Speed Limit Ordinance Adoption 2020-08
8K.
Agreement with Specialty Mowing Services, Inc. for citywide abatement services. Contact Person: Field Supervisor Tobin
1) Authorize the Acting City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Citywide Abatement Services Agreement in substantial form between the City of Encinitas and Specialty Mowing Services, Inc. for an initial two-year term, and all options to extend upon satisfactory performance and mutual agreement, for a total amount not to exceed $443,632.
2020-06-10 Item 08K Agreement with Specialty Mowing Services for Abatement
8L.
Coronavirus Relief Funds Subgrant Agreement. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Authorize the Acting City Manager to execute a Coronavirus Relief Funds Subgrant Agreement with the County of San Diego and receive grant funds.
2020-06-10 Item 08L Coronavirus Relief Funds Subgrant Agreement
8M.
Ratification of letters sent in support for or opposition to for various topics. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
1) A reimbursement for SANDAG from the State of California for expenses due to an unfunded mandate to have auditors on staff; and 2) Support for SB 793 (Hill) that would ban the sale of flavored tobacco in the State of California.
2020-06-10 Item 08M Ratification of Letters Sent in Support for or Opposition to Various Topics
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public comments regarding Action Items listed on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov.
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
10A.
Amendments to City Council Policy No. C035: Small Wireless Facilities and approval of a template Master License Agreement for Wireless Facilities on Vertical Infrastructure in the Public Rights-of-Way with a site license fee. Contact Person: Acting Director of Development Services Sapa'u
1. Receive the report and presentation by staff and Telecom Law Firm, PC, City WirelessFacilities Special Legal Counsel; and
2.Adopt Resolution No. 2020-38 (Attachment CC-1) implementing amendments to CityCouncil Policy No. C-035: Small Wire Facilities for the regulation of small wirelessfacilities and other infrastructure deployments in the public rights-of-way; and
3.Approve a template Master License Agreement for Wireless Facilities on VerticalInfrastructure in the Public Rights-of-Way (Attachment CC-6) and adopt a Site LicenseFee of $270 per year for each attachment to a City-owned structure in the public rights-of-way

2020-06-10 Item 10A Small Cell Wireless Attachment CC-7 - Correspondence 4
10B.
Encroachment and Excavation Policies for Wireline Telecommunication Facilities. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Approve the Encroachment and Excavation Policies for Wireline Telecommunication Facilities (Policy).
2020-06-10 Item 10B Encroachment & Excavation Policies for Wireline Telecommunication Facilities
10C.
Evaluation of the North Leucadia/Saxony Canyon Peak Hour Fast Response Vehicle Pilot Program. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
Discontinue the Fast Response Vehicle (FRV) Pilot Program based on findings.
2020-06-10 Item 10C Evaluation of FRV Pilot Program

INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE

COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JUNE 17, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
